ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

clock_waveform.Clock_Lane_DDR: Host drives differential Clock Lane (Clock+ / Clock-). Both rising and falling edges latch one bit per Data Lane → data-rate-per-lane = 2 × Clock-Lane-Hz. Clock Lane is host → peripheral ONLY; peripheral never drives Clock Lane.
clock_waveform.HS_clock_swing_inherits: D-PHY HS — 100-200 mV differential (sub-LVDS, 100 Ω terminated).
clock_waveform.Continuous_Clock_Mode: Clock Lane remains in HS forever; Data Lanes alternate HS/LP per burst. All DSI transmitters and receivers SHALL support Continuous Clock behavior.
clock_waveform.Non_Continuous_Clock_Mode: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between HS data packet transmissions; optional support.

hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_1_stop: LP-11 on both Dp and Dn (Stop state).
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_2_request: LP-01 (Dp LOW, Dn HIGH) for T-LPX.
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_4_prepare: HS driver switches on; HS-0 for T-HS-PREPARE.
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_5_zero: Continue HS-0 for T-HS-ZERO — receiver locks DDR clock-data alignment.
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_6_sync: Transmit 8-bit Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire = 10111000).
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_7_payload: Stream DSI packet bytes at HS rate; byte k → lane (k mod N).
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_8_eotp: (Optional) Append EoTp Short Packet DI=0x08, payload=0x0F0F, ECC=0x01 when EoTp is enabled.
hs_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_phy.step_10_exit: Disable HS driver; LP driver returns LP-11 (Stop state).

escape_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_p.step_2_request: LP-10 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX.
escape_entry_waveform_inherited_from_d_p.step_4_escape_pattern: Transmit Escape Entry command + payload (LPDT data, Trigger code, or Reset code) at LP rate.

bta_waveform.step_1_host_lp11: Host has finished the last packet of the transmission; both Lanes in LP-11.
bta_waveform.step_2_host_request: Host PHY drives BTA escape sequence on Data Lane 0 (per D-PHY).
bta_waveform.step_3_peripheral_takes_bus: Peripheral PHY recognizes BTA; peripheral transitions to LP-TX; sends ACK / Error Report / Read Response in LP mode.
bta_waveform.step_4_peripheral_returns_bus: Peripheral PHY drives BTA escape sequence to hand bus back to host.
bta_waveform.step_5_host_resumes: Host returns to LP-11 Stop state; bus possession restored.

te_signaling_waveform.step_1_setup: Host gives bus possession to peripheral via BTA WITHOUT an accompanying DSI command transmission.
te_signaling_waveform.step_2_te_event: Display module detects TE event (e.g. vertical blanking start).
te_signaling_waveform.step_3_te_send: Display module sends LP Escape Mode sequence, then trigger message byte 0x5D (LSB-first 10111010).
te_signaling_waveform.step_4_bta_return: Display module returns bus possession to host via BTA.

powerup_waveform.step_5_rx_sm_active: Peripheral Rx State Machine becomes active; T_INIT_SLAVE timer begins; T_INTERNAL_DELAY may follow.
powerup_waveform.step_6_host_lp11_drive: Host has been driving LP-11 on all Lanes throughout T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY.
powerup_waveform.step_7_clock_active: Host Clock Lane transitions LP-11 → HS-0 → DDR clock waveform begins.
powerup_waveform.step_8_data_active: Host Data Lanes transition LP-11 → HS at first burst transmission.

video_mode_timing_legend.VSS: DSI Sync Event Packet: V Sync Start (DT=0x01)
video_mode_timing_legend.VSE: DSI Sync Event Packet: V Sync End (DT=0x11)
video_mode_timing_legend.BLLP: DSI Packet: Arbitrary sequence of non-restricted DSI packets or Low Power Mode including optional BTA
video_mode_timing_legend.HSS: DSI Sync Event Packet: H Sync Start (DT=0x21)
video_mode_timing_legend.HSA: DSI Blanking Packet: Horizontal Sync Active, no data
video_mode_timing_legend.HSE: DSI Sync Event Packet: H Sync End (DT=0x31)
video_mode_timing_legend.HFP: DSI Blanking Packet: Horizontal Front Porch or Low Power Mode
video_mode_timing_legend.HBP: DSI Blanking Packet: Horizontal Back Porch or Low Power Mode
video_mode_timing_legend.RGB: DSI Packet: Arbitrary sequence of pixel stream and Null Packets
video_mode_timing_legend.LPM: Low Power Mode including optional BTA

video_mode_sequences.non_burst_with_sync_pulses: VSA(VSS+BLLP+VSE) ... VBP(HSS+BLLP) ... VACT(HSS+HSA+HSE+HBP+RGB+HFP) ... VFP(HSS+BLLP) ... — fully matches DPI-style timing including sync pulse widths.
video_mode_sequences.non_burst_with_sync_events: VSA(VSS+BLLP) ... VBP(HSS+BLLP) ... VACT(HSS+HBP+RGB+HFP) ... VFP(HSS+BLLP) ... VSS — only Sync Start events transmitted; peripheral regenerates sync pulses locally.
video_mode_sequences.burst_mode: VSA(VSS+BLLP) ... VBP(HSS+BLLP) ... VACT(HSS+HBP+RGB+BLLP+HFP) ... VFP(HSS+BLLP) ... — RGB packet time-compressed leaving more time for LP or other transmissions.

payload_byte_serialization.format: Each byte transmitted LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 7 last).
payload_byte_serialization.header_byte_order: DI (byte 0), WC LS Byte (byte 1), WC MS Byte (byte 2), ECC (byte 3).
payload_byte_serialization.checksum_byte_order: CRC LS Byte first, then CRC MS Byte.
payload_byte_serialization.multilane_interleave: With N Lanes: byte k → lane (k mod N); SoT replicated on every active Lane; some Lanes may EoT one byte earlier than others when WC not multiple of N.

data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_11: Stop state — Dp and Dn at 1.2 V CMOS HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_01: HS Request — Dp LOW, Dn HIGH
data_signaling_waveforms_inherited.LP_10: Escape Request / Mark-One — Dp HIGH, Dn LOW

general_timing_rule: All HS payload bit timings derive from UI = 1 / data-rate-per-lane = 1 / (2 × Clock-Lane Hz). DDR clock: both edges of Clock+/Clock- latch one Data-Lane bit. Detailed numeric T-LPX / T-HS-PREPARE / T-HS-ZERO / T-HS-TRAIL bounds inherit from D-PHY v0.90.00 specification, referenced as [4] in DSI §3.5.
